steps.eval: (()=>{ const g=__rhf.game, f=g.fishing, W=g.world, P=g.player; __rhf.god(true); g.bears.directorT=9999; window.__banners=[]; const ban=g.hud.banner.bind(g.hud); g.hud.banner=(m,c,s)=>{ __banners.push(m+(s?' / '+s:'')); return ban(m,c,s); }; window.__toasts=[]; const to=g.hud.toast.bind(g.hud); g.hud.toast=(m,k)=>{ __toasts.push(m); return to(m,k); }; const pl=W.place('landing'); P.place(pl.x,pl.z,pl.face||0); let spot=null; for (const d of [10,14,18]) for (const a of [0,-30,30]) { const yaw=(pl.face||0)+a*Math.PI/180; const x=P.pos.x-Math.sin(yaw)*d, z=P.pos.z-Math.cos(yaw)*d; const w=W.waterAt(x,z); if (!spot&&w&&w.depth>0.6) spot={x,z,w}; } window.__spot=spot; window.__wait=()=>{ f.cancel(); f.water=spot.w; f.float.position.set(spot.x,spot.w.level,spot.z); f.floatBase=spot.w.level; f.float.visible=true; f.state='waiting'; }; return spot?'water at '+spot.x.toFixed(0)+','+spot.z.toFixed(0):'no water'; })()

(()=>{ const g=__rhf.game, f=g.fishing; __wait(); f.startEncounter(); const e=f.encounter; e.phase='bite'; e.t=e.window*0.2; f.hook(); const F=f.fight; const r='quick hook set: clean '+F.clean+', fish stamina '+F.stamina+', banners '+JSON.stringify(__banners.slice(-1)); __wait(); f.startEncounter(); const e2=f.encounter; e2.phase='bite'; e2.t=e2.window*0.8; __banners.length=0; f.hook(); const F2=f.fight; const r2=' | late hook set: clean '+F2.clean+', fish stamina '+F2.stamina+', banners '+JSON.stringify(__banners.slice(-1)); f.cancel(); return r+r2; })()

(()=>{ const g=__rhf.game, f=g.fishing; __wait(); f.startEncounter(); f.encounter.phase='bite'; f.encounter.t=0; f.hook(); const F=f.fight; const before=F.stamina; F.state='jump'; F.stateT=1.15; F.jumpT=0.44; F.jumpChecked=false; F.dist=Math.max(F.dist,8); __toasts.length=0; f.updateFight(0.05,false,g.input); const bowed=F.bows; const after=F.stamina; F.state='run'; F.stateT=5; F.dir=1; F.rodSide=1; F.turnT=0; F.turned=false; g.input.stick.active=true; g.input.stick.x=1; for (let i=0;i<20;i++) f.updateFight(0.1,false,g.input); g.input.stick.active=false; g.input.stick.x=0; const r='bowed to the jump: bows '+bowed+', stamina '+before.toFixed(2)+' -> '+after.toFixed(2)+', turns '+F.turns+', after the turn the fish '+F.state+' and the drag '+(g.audio.screamOn?'on':'off')+', toasts '+JSON.stringify(__toasts); f.cancel(); return r; })()

(()=>{ const g=__rhf.game, f=g.fishing, s=g.state; s.stats.streak=0; s.cooler.length=0; const out=[]; for (let i=0;i<3;i++) { f.fight={fish:{species:'coho',weight:3.4,legend:null}, clean:i===0, bows:i===1?2:0, turns:0}; f.finishCatch(); out.push('catch '+(i+1)+': value '+f.catchInfo.value+', bonus '+JSON.stringify(f.catchInfo.bonus)+', card bonus line '+JSON.stringify(document.getElementById('catch-bonus').hidden?'(hidden)':document.getElementById('catch-bonus').textContent)); document.getElementById('catch-release').click(); } f.fight={fish:{species:'coho',weight:3.4,legend:null}}; f.state='fight'; f.lose('test',false,null); out.push('after a lost fish: streak '+s.stats.streak); return out.join(' | '); })()

(()=>{ const g=__rhf.game, f=g.fishing, s=g.state; s.cooler.length=0; while (s.cooler.length<s.coolerCap()) s.cooler.push({species:'grayling',weight:0.5,length:30,value:50+s.cooler.length,legend:null,name:'Arctic Grayling'}); const cheapest=s.cheapestInCooler(); f.fight={fish:{species:'king',weight:12,legend:null}}; f.finishCatch(); const keep=document.getElementById('catch-keep'); const r='full cooler, valuable catch: button '+JSON.stringify(keep.firstChild.textContent)+', disabled '+keep.disabled+', info '+JSON.stringify(document.getElementById('catch-info').textContent); keep.click(); const has=s.cooler.some(c=>c.species==='king'); const gone=!s.cooler.includes(cheapest); f.fight={fish:{species:'grayling',weight:0.3,legend:null}}; f.finishCatch(); const r2=' | kept the king '+has+', cheapest gone '+gone+', cooler '+s.cooler.length+'/'+s.coolerCap()+' | cheap catch: button '+JSON.stringify(keep.firstChild.textContent)+', disabled '+keep.disabled; document.getElementById('catch-release').click(); s.cooler.length=0; return r+r2; })()

(()=>{ const g=__rhf.game, f=g.fishing; __wait(); const mean=(n)=>{ let s=0; for (let i=0;i<n;i++) s+=f.approachDelay(); return s/n; }; let mx=0; for (let i=0;i<2000;i++) mx=Math.max(mx,f.approachDelay()); const m0=mean(400); __banners.length=0; f.startFrenzy(); const m1=mean(400); f.startEncounter(); const skip=f.encounter.skipNibble; const r='wait: mean '+m0.toFixed(1)+' s, longest of 2000 '+mx.toFixed(1)+' s | frenzy: here '+f.frenzyHere()+', mean wait '+m1.toFixed(1)+' s, straight to the take '+skip+', banners '+JSON.stringify(__banners); f.frenzy=null; f.cancel(); return r; })()

(()=>{ const g=__rhf.game, f=g.fishing; __wait(); f.nextApproach=30; f.encounter=null; const base=f.nextApproach; __toasts.length=0; const tw=()=>{ g.input.pressedOnce=true; f.updateWaiting(0.01,true,false,false); }; f.t=100; tw(); const a=f.nextApproach; f.t=100.3; tw(); f.t=100.6; tw(); f.t=100.9; tw(); const b=f.nextApproach; f.cancel(); return 'twitch after a pause: wait '+base.toFixed(1)+' -> '+a.toFixed(1)+' | a flurry of three: '+b.toFixed(1)+', toasts '+JSON.stringify(__toasts); })()

(()=>{ const g=__rhf.game, f=g.fishing; f.cancel(); f.backlash(); let t=0; let taps=0; while (f.state==='tangle' && t<5) { const tap=taps<20 && (Math.round(t*10)%2===0); if (tap) taps++; f.t2 -= 0.1 + (tap?0.35:0); t+=0.1; if (f.t2<=0) { f.state='idle'; g.player.moveLocked=false; } } return 'backlash picked out by tapping in '+t.toFixed(1)+' s (2.4 s without tapping)'; })()

(()=>{ const g=__rhf.game, s=g.state, h=g.hud; const open=s.openChallenges(3).map(c=>c.id); const seen=[]; for (let i=0;i<4;i++) { h.goalT=0; h.update(0.016); seen.push(h.goalShown?h.goalShown.id:'none'); } return 'first three open goals '+JSON.stringify(open)+', the goal line in turn '+JSON.stringify(seen)+', text '+JSON.stringify(document.getElementById('objective')?.textContent||''); })()

(()=>{ const g=__rhf.game, f=g.fishing, B=g.bears, P=g.player; g.state.cooler.push({species:'coho',weight:3,length:60,value:30,legend:null,name:'Coho Salmon'}); const b=B.bears.find(x=>!x.dead); if (!b) return 'no bear'; b.x=P.pos.x+30; b.z=P.pos.z; b.state='stalk'; b.t=0.01; b.growlT=99; B.threat=null; __wait(); f.startEncounter(); f.encounter.phase='bite'; f.hook(); for (let i=0;i<30;i++) B.update(0.05); const during='during the fight: bear '+b.state+', threat '+(B.threat?'yes':'no'); f.cancel(); b.x=P.pos.x+30; b.z=P.pos.z; b.state='stalk'; b.t=0.01; for (let i=0;i<10;i++) B.update(0.05); const after=' | after it: bear '+b.state+', threat '+(B.threat?'yes':'no'); B.threat=null; b.state='retreat'; b.t=10; g.state.cooler.length=0; return during+after; })()

(()=>{ const g=__rhf.game, f=g.fishing, s=g.state, A=g.audio, h=g.hud; const out=[]; __wait(); f.startEncounter(); f.encounter.phase='bite'; f.hook(); A.creak(0.9); const c0=A.creakAmt; f.lose('test',true,null); out.push('rod creak '+c0+' before a snap, '+A.creakAmt+' after'); s.stats.streak=4; __wait(); f.startEncounter(); f.encounter.phase='bite'; f.hook(); __toasts.length=0; f.cancel(); out.push('a fish on the line dropped: streak '+s.stats.streak+', toasts '+JSON.stringify(__toasts)); f.state='landing'; s.stats.streak=0; f.finishCatch(); f.settleCatch(); out.push('a card closed by something else with a full cooler: kings in the cooler '+s.cooler.filter(c=>c.species==='king').length+', graylings '+s.cooler.filter(c=>c.species==='grayling').length); s.cooler.length=0; const open=s.openChallenges(3); h.resetGoal(); h.update(0.016); const first=h.goalShown&&h.goalShown.id; const m1=h.minimap.getGoal(); h.goalT=0; h.update(0.016); const second=h.goalShown&&h.goalShown.id;
